summary: Story roll-up for ask-reopen-saved-report across both sealed tasks. Each already carried its own clean three-lens pass; reopen-navigation-and-scroll finished at quality 10 / performance 10 / security 10 after a three-round loop that retired an aborted-reopen empty turn and a document-wide scroll lookup. All nineteen task contracts are implemented; 133/133 frontend tests and verify.py pass in the story worktree; the live functional check confirmed reuse-not-append and the user's own question text on the request body. Navigate-first removes a round trip from the perceived path - the Ask panel mounts immediately rather than after the response - and a matched open reuses its turn instead of rendering a duplicate. The scroll lookup is scoped to the panel's own thread by ref rather than a document-wide getElementById. No polling, no added queries, and an abandoned reopen removes its placeholder rather than retaining dead state.

contract_verdicts.evidence: Live: reopening a pin whose selection structurally matched an existing turn left the thread at 2 turns - re-run in place, nothing appended.

Live: three pins share the byte-identical title 'actual, budget - Governed financial' with differing selections and produce distinct turns; selection-identity.helper.ts is strict structural equality including array order.
Live: the pin carrying no dimensionIds and no timeWindow did NOT match the gl_code/July turn and opened a new one, exactly as the criterion requires.
use-ask.ts reverses the turn list before selecting a candidate, so the most recent match is re-run; covered by a shipped leaf.

Live on the REQUEST BODY, where the criterion says to assert it: the reopen posted question='Show actual and budget by GL code for July 2026' - the user's own wording - not the pin label 'Actual - Budget'. One POST /api/chat per Open confirmed in the network log.

Only blocked_by_policy and a terminal 401/403 clear; everything else including not_supported retains, per the 2026-09-15 amendment to decision 0028. The residual gap is ledgered as D-0048. NOT forced live - it needs a grant revoked mid-session against the shared warehouse - and is covered by leaves.
ask-period-control's shipped retain-on-refusal leaf passes UNMODIFIED in the 133-test suite.
A cleared turn carries a result-free renderable state and the leaf asserts the numbers are ABSENT FROM THE DOM rather than merely that an error string appeared.
continueTurn's policy argument is required and ask-panel.tsx's two period-control calls pass 'retain' explicitly; the suite type-checks under verify.py.
frontend/src/features/exploration/selection-identity.helper.ts exists under the constitution's Helper convention and is stateless and IO-free.
A terminal 401/403 clears the numbers and shows generic sign-in copy on that turn without redirecting, so one unauthorized report cannot discard the thread. Covered by leaves; not forced live.
Live: three in-app Open cycles each reached /ask within 80ms of the click, before the request resolved.
use-ask.ts appends exactly one pending turn on the unmatched path and settles it in place; the abort path REMOVES the placeholder rather than leaving a question with nothing under it.
A matched open routes through task 1's continueTurn and appends no turn; live cycles held the thread at one turn.
The thread container carries a ref and the target is resolved inside it, so a panel can only scroll its OWN turn; the docked surface emits no id. Live: the target was in view after every cycle.
Both Open handlers check isAskPending first, show the existing row message and do NOT navigate.
pinned-reports.tsx and saved-views.tsx share the identical navigate-first flow.
A refused reopen renders its own reason on that turn rather than continueTurn's period-specific copy.

Task 1's fifteen leaves pass with their bodies byte-identical; selection-identity.helper.test.ts is untouched and the only deletions in use-ask.test.tsx are its shared Harness fixtures adapting to AskTurn.response becoming optional while pending.

residual_risks: D-0048: a revoked domain or measure grant returns not_supported, indistinguishable from a missing mapping, so the previous answer is deliberately retained.
D-0049: reopen failure copy still says 'reopened' where the flow now says Open/Opening; two of the three strings are task 1's and asserted by its leaves.
D-0050: pins with colliding titles are indistinguishable in the Dashboard and Explore lists.
The access-refusal criteria were proven by leaves, not live, because forcing them needs a grant revoked mid-session against the shared warehouse.
